svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two blanks 260 x 296 mm. Heights below are up from the bottom edge;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 'toward the row' and 'toward the dock' are along the 260 mm edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Axle holes 12 mm, 90 each side of centre, 116 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lower plate only: brush shaft hole 22 mm on the centre line, 135.5 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stop button hole 22 mm, 95 toward the row, 265 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bearing bolt holes: drill through the bought flange bearings

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: once they are centred on the axle and brush holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hook slider: two 6.5 mm holes 13 each side of centre, 40 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cleat holes 6.5 mm, 37 each side of centre, 240 and 270 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Housing flange, clevis, bracket and seat holes: drill through each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: part in place, 3.3 mm, and tap M4 (marked from the part).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The upper plate is the mirror image, without the brush hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr; round the corners 3 mm. Check: axle holes 180 apart.
